gist.headline: One more bee in the hive
gist.blurb: The GitHub contributor list gained a new name. A small gate opened, and aikhusus2025-ctrl can now get on with the useful work.
gist.summary: Added the GitHub ID `aikhusus2025-ctrl` to the shared authorization list used by Pollinations services.
gist.impact: The newly listed contributor can access the GitHub-authenticated workflow that relies on this shared allowlist.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden-gate metaphor for adding a contributor to a shared GitHub authorization list: Polli, wearing a tiny maintainer cap, welcomes a new name onto a glowing retro terminal roster beside an open garden gate and code-plants.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and a tiny maintainer cap, adding a new glowing name to a retro terminal's contributor roster beside an open garden gate and sprouting code-plants. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with subtle pixel-font text: 'WELCOME'. Nostalgic but beautiful, emotionally warm.
